final: WITH grouped_counts AS (SELECT translink, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior GROUP BY translink), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM grouped_counts) SELECT SUM(g.record_count), AVG(g.record_count - a.avg_count) FROM grouped_counts AS g CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND g.record_count > a.avg_count
